title: Grateful Dead Live at Ungano's Night Club on 1970-02-12
source: SBD > 8 TRACK 1" RTR @ 7.5 I.P.S. > MASTER ARCHIVE 24-BIT D > SSSB

ai_review.summary: Vault‑sourced soundboard capture of an inspired early‑Feb 1970 show, highlighted by Bob Weir’s fiery playing.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear vault‑style soundboard quality and delivers a performance that fans find as inspiring as the famous 2‑13‑70 shows, despite a different song selection. Reviewers especially note Bob (Weir) “hotter than hell” throughout. Some confusion exists about the exact date, but overall the audio and musical delivery are well‑received.

ai_rating.rationale: Two strong positive reviews highlight both performance and sound quality; a few ambiguous or low‑information reviews lower certainty, yielding a solid but not definitive rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Vault‑style soundboard with clear mix; no specific audio complaints noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑Feb ’70 set with a different song selection than the famed 2‑13‑70 show, yet still regarded as inspired and energetic.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby (Bob Weir) is described as “hotter than hell all through this.”
